problem: Image resizing in a Node.js API blocks the event loop, so all other requests stall for up to 2 s
context: The resize is pure JavaScript (no native module), called inside an Express handler.
key_facts: async/await does not move CPU-bound JavaScript off the main thread. UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE only sizes libuv's pool for I/O and some native modules, not ordinary JavaScript.
constraints: Other requests must keep being served while an image is resized

options.summary: Run the resize in a pool of worker_threads and await the result in the handler
Make the resize function async and await it in the handler

criteria.description: Keeps the event loop free during resizes

expected.why: Only worker threads move CPU-bound JS off the main thread; the other two are common misconceptions.
